questions.question: The story about boiling a watch instead of an egg should not be attributed to Ampère without a source: Camille Flammarion’s Popular Astronomy (1884) assigns this episode to Newton and gives a different anecdote for Ampère. Provide a source specifically supporting the Ampère attribution or revise RU/EN consistently.
